sentence: This project gets a mass spectrometer that measures the masses of large molecules such as polymers, peptides and proteins.
This project builds a virtual reality course that teaches cybersecurity to adults with autism, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and dyslexia.
This project studies how metal powder that is not spherical behaves when a laser melts it in additive manufacturing.
This project studies whether a partnership between community colleges and a small private university helps people who transfer between schools finish degrees in science and mathematics.
This project adds time-resolved spectroscopy to an open-source software platform that simulates how electrons and nuclei behave in chemical processes.
This project builds and tests prediction markets where people and AI traders together forecast how users experience social media.
This project builds a clearer framework for the engram, the way the brain holds a memory, by studying how neuroscientists have thought about it.
This project studies how the shape of lattice materials makes one edge soft and the opposite edge rigid, and designs materials to control this.
This project brings researchers together to write a roadmap that connects mechanics to emerging fields such as quantum technologies and space exploration.
This project designs mathematical tools that guide large groups of drones and robots by treating them as a spreading density over a region.
This project builds software that lets scientists fetch the same data in different forms, so less data has to be moved.
This project studies how chemicals shape the way plants and animals interact and why their traits vary.
This project tests whether the brain chemical dopamine helps cause the loss of myelin that follows long social isolation in mice.
This project studies how features of shape help sort complex mathematical structures called operator algebras into groups.
This project builds fast computer simulation software to predict and improve how well inverse Compton sources make hard x-rays.
This project works to make communication with visible light practical for mobile devices, using machine learning and better signal designs.
This project uses laser pulses to watch how molecules react on 2D materials in light-driven reactions that make fuels from water and carbon dioxide.
